message.content: It's a catheter that goes into my urinary pouch, the one I had made after my bladder was removed for cancer. I've had trouble getting a catheter in for weeks, so they put in a catheter to stay in and drain all the time. It stopped draining the night before I came in, and I've been making much less urine since. After that, the lower belly pain got really bad, and then I started feeling more and more short of breath. It wasn't sudden at first, it built up over time. I haven't mentioned a fever or chills, and I don't know about passing gas, since you didn't ask me that before and I haven't said anything about it.
